title: 67_Basketball_Woes

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which activity did you like best?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whoever this expert is, he knows what he's doing.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Seriously. These will be three epic days. Guys' night, chicks at the mall, and chicks at the beach.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess... It could be cool. Especially if chicks are involved...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Who gave you these tips, man?! They suck!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm already bummed enough as it is!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Wait. I'll take over. Leave it to the leading scorer on the team, Jacob...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What Jacob meant to say was this: one day we have a Guys' Night, one day we pick up chicks at the mall, another day we go clean up a beach and check out girls in bikinis...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Sound good?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know why you didn't just say that in the first place, man! That's why we suck so much.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Great. First day of building team chemistry, and I've already got a strike against me.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Like a beach clean-up? That doesn't sound fun...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We aren't tree-huggers!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Guys... Three magic words... `Chicks. In. Bikinis.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys... Three magic words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Chicks. In. Bikinis.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: So magical.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sold!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I like animals, but I don't want to have to milk them, man.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Or help any of them give birth!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Woah! Just what do you guys think we're going to be doing?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't actually know... Do you?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I guess I don't...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: So maybe to be safe we won't do that and that way no one has to milk anything.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Are you crazy?!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Why would we want to spend `more` time at school?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would we want to spend [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] time at school?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Poor form, Jacob. Poor form.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We could volunteer at the... Volunteer place.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Are you okay, Jacob?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That could be fun. I like places.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Or, we can go do volunteer work at the...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Dude, we're not chicks!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, Jacob, what are you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Terrible idea... Though I `could` use a new eyepatch...
nodes.text_bbcode: Terrible idea... Though I [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] use a new eyepatch...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What are we, goats?!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Strange idea, man.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Baaaaad idea, even.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I like it.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Let's do that!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I can be a wingman!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Do... Things... There.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Why are you talking like a TV space captain?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm... Not... Sure.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We can also go to the mall and...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Um... What's a lumber party?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It's, um, a party where we all bring over... Blocks of wood and... Whittle together.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That's weird. Even to me. And I think I'm probably the weirdest one here.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Guys' night! That could be fun...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What would we do?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know. Eat junk food. Watch a movie. Guy stuff.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It sounds like...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Like we're about to participate in a Japanese game show.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We can do a sleeping thing... With guys.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry, I spaced for a second... Never mind. Forget that. Please.
After the girls' team practice ends, Jacob meets up with Kim...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So, what's the trick to team chemistry?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's simple... You guys never spend time with each other outside of basketball. If you're going to develop any chemistry, you've got to do stuff together `off the court.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's simple... You guys never spend time with each other outside of basketball. If you're going to develop any chemistry, you've got to do stuff together [color=#3b78e2][i]off the court.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What kind of stuff?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, we do girly things... Like get manicures, have slumber parties, go shopping at the mall. Sometimes we'll do volunteer work.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Those things probably aren't going to fly with the guys.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I do have a tough time imagining Kenji and Phil braiding each other's hair in their pajamas.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But maybe you can do more guy-appealing versions of those things...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Kim? Are we getting cupcakes or are we flirting with losers?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Relax!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Erg. Sorry about that, Jacob. I've gotta go. Sometimes I wish I weren't the captain...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I hear ya...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Looks like I'll have to figure out the guy-appealing versions on my own.
After school that day, the guys are gathered in Jacob's room...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Where's the new nerd?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Erik?! To be honest, I didn't even think to ask him here.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Who cares about him? What are `we` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who cares about him? What are [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You're not going to have us rank girls by hotness like the cheerleaders do, right? Hector said those meetings are horrible!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Relax, no hotness rankings. Truthfully, guys, we've been stinking it up on the court. I've consulted with an anonymous expert, and `they've` given me some tips.
nodes.text_bbcode: Relax, no hotness rankings. Truthfully, guys, we've been stinking it up on the court. I've consulted with an anonymous expert, and [color=#e23b3b][i]they've[/i][/color] given me some tips.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Finally, someone who can help me nail three-pointers!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No, our court skills are fine. We are going to work on our chemistry.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This sounds a lot like `school.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This sounds a lot like [color=#e23b3b][i]school.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Here goes... Time to spin Kim's list into guy-appealing things...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No, see, it's not that bad... Um, one thing we can do is have a...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What's a more guy-appealing phrase for 'slumber party?'

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So what?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't think the guys will be very receptive to getting basketball advice from a girl.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tough! They'll just have to deal with it!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know. Andy `might` be okay with it, but I can't say the same for Kenji and Phil.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know. Andy [color=#e23b3b][i]might[/i][/color] be okay with it, but I can't say the same for Kenji and Phil.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh. I didn't even think about how Phil would feel about all this. The last thing he'll want is his ex-girlfriend telling him what to do. How's he doing?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Um... He's... Not himself.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: All right. We'll keep it a secret.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But for Phil's sake, and `not` because I'm a girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: But for Phil's sake, and [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] because I'm a girl.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is he okay?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Um... Not exactly. I think he's still hurting, you know. You've got Tom now, and he's got no one.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: All right, then. We'll keep it a secret.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks for being thoughtful, Jacob.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But how, Coach?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Let me tell you something, son. I was coaching basketball when you were in diapers. In all that time, my teams have `never` missed the playoffs. We've got one game left against Spartan Academy, and we `have` to win it if we're going to get in.

We've got one game left against Spartan Academy, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to win it if we're going to get in.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: So you're going to do `whatever it takes` to get the team back that same fire it had in Spirit Week.
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're going to do [color=#e23b3b][i]whatever it takes[/i][/color] to get the team back that same fire it had in Spirit Week.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: In the meantime, if things look promising this week, practices will be a breeze. Otherwise, if I see even a hint of all this namby-pamby, diva-bickering... You guys will be running. And running. And running! And it will be `your` fault. We clear?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Gulp. Everyone's going to be watching the last game of the season! If we don't win against Spartan not only will Coach be disappointed, but the whole school will hate us!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're clear, Coach...
The next day, Jacob walks in on the girls' basketball practice...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, I'm open!
Kim heaves the ball downcourt to Mallika. Instead of taking a difficult shot, she passes it to Jane, who scores with an easy lay-up.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yes! That's what I'm talking about, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Just like the donut from this weekend!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ha! First you guys are throwing donuts to each other at my house, now you're throwing each other great passes in practice!
Kim sees you and jogs over...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What's up, Jacob? I saw that blowout yesterday. You guys going to beat Spartan next week and make the playoffs?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's why I'm here. Captain-to-captain, I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm wondering if you can give me some tips on how to boost our team chemistry. We've got none, and it's obvious you girls do.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Of course! I can help you guys after practice...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: The guys will `never` go along with this if they know I'm getting help from a girl, but I don't know if I can tell Kim that.
nodes.text_bbcode: The guys will [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] go along with this if they know I'm getting help from a girl, but I don't know if I can tell Kim that.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I think we should keep this a secret, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's precisely the kind of prima-donna thinking that's plaguing us! I won't stand for finger-pointing on this team!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Sure, Kenji's a maelstrom of soul-sapping pessimism. Yes, ever since Andy hit that game-winner, he won't pass the ball to anyone... Even if it were soaked in cat urine. And even `I` know Phil's still got lingering relationship issues with that Kim girl.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But the real problem is that we're lacking the intangible quality that makes champions... `Chemistry.` You need to get along with each other!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's what I expect from my captain. When I gave you an opportunity to complain, you kept your mouth shut!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: The real problem is that we're lacking the intangible quality that makes champions... `Chemistry.` You need to get along with each other!
Jacob passes the ball to Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Phil!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Focus, man!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: He's still hung up on Kim! Give it to me, Kenji, I'm open!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Andy, you're too far out. You have no depth perception!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, guys, get it to me!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Shut up, nerd!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: If Kenji gets the ball to Andy, Andy can pass it to me for an easy lay-up!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Pass it to Andy, Kenji!
Kenji reluctantly passes the ball to Andy.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Andy, I'm open!
Instead of passing it to Jacob, Andy shoots a long three-pointer... And misses! Phil is too lost in thought to get the rebound. The buzzer sounds. The game is over.
Later, Coach wraps up his post-game tirade...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: ...Mommies and girlfriends! Now get outta my sight. Your sad, sorry faces gives me the dry heaves.
As the team shuffles out, Coach pulls Jacob aside.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Jacob, tell me what you think's wrong with this team?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah! What's wrong with you, guys?!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's wrong with us? Have you seen the score? We're down by twenty points. The game is over, man.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Coach is in our faces enough as it is! We don't need you yelling at us, too. Besides, I definitely don't need a lecture from someone who's scored fewer points than me.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Guys! Let's get it together! We still have time for one more play!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But we're down by twenty points!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Captain Negativity, at it again.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: At least Jacob's got the right attitude.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Hey, if you get me the ball, I might be able to break my own scoring record!

nodes.title: Basketball Woes
nodes.subtitle: Can Jacob bring the basketball team together?

nodes.text: You're playing as Jacob, the boys' basketball team captain!
Unfortunately, the team is about to lose `another` game... One that will ruin their chances of making the playoffs!
nodes.text_bbcode: Unfortunately, the team is about to lose [b]another[/b] game... One that will ruin their chances of making the playoffs!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I can't believe we're about to lose `another` game. Our three best players have fallen apart!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe we're about to lose [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] game. Our three best players have fallen apart!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Phil's sad and unfocused since his break-up with Kim.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Kenji's never been much of a team player.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And Andy's become a ball-hog ever since he hit that game-winning shot.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What are you numb-knuckled monkeys doing out there?! We're getting creamed, and you're daydreaming 'bout your mommies and girlfriends! `GET YOUR HEADS ON STRAIGHT!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you numb-knuckled monkeys doing out there?! We're getting creamed, and you're daydreaming 'bout your mommies and girlfriends! [color=#e23b3b][i]GET YOUR HEADS ON STRAIGHT![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wow. Coach is `really` angry... But he's right. It's like the whole team's asleep.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Coach is [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] angry... But he's right. It's like the whole team's asleep.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We've got time for one more play. We can still save face. How do I motivate the guys? Should I get angry like Coach? Or adopt a more positive attitude?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: The clock counts down... Three... Two... One...
Jacob shoots the last bit of trash into the bag!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That was actually kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I didn't think we could do it. It looks... Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm sorry for doubting the team... I shouldn't have been such a sourpuss.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't worry about it...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Guys, look! Check it out!
A couple of college girls arrive...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hellooooo, sun!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Look how nice this beach looks.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: I know! It is `so` clean! It's almost like the beach itself is naked!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! It is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] clean! It's almost like the beach itself is naked!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Don't get any ideas...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We have created heaven.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Quitting is unacceptable! Start over!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Crap.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's enough, ladies! Get outta my sight!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Four! Again!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's three. Again!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's two. Again!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's one. Again!
Jacob passes the ball to Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kenji, over here!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yeah right!
Kenji dribbles all the way downcourt on his own, then throws up a terrible shot. Phil doesn't even jump for the rebound.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That's why you should give `me` the ball!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's why you should give [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color] the ball!

nodes.text: Coach blows his whistle!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Enough! You guys bicker so much I feel like I'm at home with my wife and kids, and that's a feeling I try to escape! So, we're going to run as punishment.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ready... Run!
Jacob passes the ball to Kenji.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Throw it to my hand, Jacob, not my feet!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Kenji, I'm open!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No way, nerd!
Kenji passes it toward Phil, but Phil isn't looking! The ball caroms out-of-bounds.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: If you had passed it to me, I could have made the shot!
Coach's whistle pierces the gym.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All right, that's it. I can't watch this me-me-me basketball you guys are so fond of playing! So instead we're going to run.
At practice the next day...
After an hour...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's it. I'm done. We've been shooting trash at these bags, and no one can make anything. I'm going swimming.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You guys suck at shooting so much, I've got garbage all over me! I quit!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: We could have spent this time working on our `actual` jump-shots. After all, The Aikido Kid is a `movie.`

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: All right. Let's go back home, guys.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I guess this wasn't such a hot idea...
At practice the next day...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Kenji! Come back here! Help us clean!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Fine. I'll help. Whatever gets us out of here faster.
The guys arrive at the beach with W.H.A.L.E...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This beach is filthy!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No chicks in bikinis...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Just seagulls in candy wrappers...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't worry, guys. If we all work together, we'll have this thing clean in no time.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Whatever, man. I'm going to go for a swim.
Kenji heads toward the water...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Kenji's always such a lone wolf. This is the perfect opportunity to show him that anything can be done with teamwork.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awesome! We could use some athletes for some of the harder tasks. I will keep you guys in mind when I'm giving out assignments...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh-oh! Harder tasks? Assignments? I don't like the sound of that.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, a bunch of guys volunteering to save the planet... It seemed too good to be true.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Still, whoever told you volunteer work is a good way to team-build knew what they were talking about.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll give you the information about the clean-up, and you guys can meet us there! And thanks for being honest about it.
Jacob and Andy return to the guys...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: How'd it go? What'd you say?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Three. Two. One. `Ker-zoop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Three. Two. One. [color=#e23b3b][i]Ker-zoop![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Hey, Phil?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey... Madisenn, right?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Yeah... Listen I wanted to say I was sorry for treating you so bad at the club the other night. I was thinking maybe we could get gelato together or something... Here's my number. Call me.
The girls leave, giggling.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wow, Jacob! `What did you say?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, Jacob! [color=#e23b3b][i]What did you say?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We'll talk about that later! She might be under some... Mis-facts about you...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Mis-facts?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Later, dude. For now, just bask, Phil. Bask in that feeling.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I said some, uh, things. But it could

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Look... They're leaving.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Wingman wings, detaching...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Girls suck.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Amen.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry, Phil. I tried for you.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I just don't think anyone's really interested in me.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ouch. I really screwed this one up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Chicks in bikinis are awesome, but I want the guys to actually see the benefits of teamwork by `cleaning` the beach.
nodes.text_bbcode: Chicks in bikinis are awesome, but I want the guys to actually see the benefits of teamwork by [color=#e23b3b][i]cleaning[/i][/color] the beach.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I don't know the first thing about beach clean-up. Maybe the environmental club can help...
Jacob finds Denni in the hall...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Jake-o! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You run the environmental club, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: W.H.A.L.E.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: W.H.A.L.E! `W`e `H`ate `A`ll `L`itterers, `E`tc.
nodes.text_bbcode: W.H.A.L.E! [color=#3b78e2][i]W[/i][/color]e [color=#3b78e2][i]H[/i][/color]ate [color=#3b78e2][i]A[/i][/color]ll [color=#3b78e2][i]L[/i][/color]itterers, [color=#3b78e2][i]E[/i][/color]tc.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Right, W.H.A.L.E. I wanted to take some of the basketball team on a beach clean-up...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! Awesome! We're going after school today, and we could use all the krill we can get... I didn't know the basketball team cared so much about the environment!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, we're doing this because we...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: T.B.M?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `T`otally `B`oyfriend `M`aterial.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]T[/i][/color]otally [color=#e23b3b][i]B[/i][/color]oyfriend [color=#e23b3b][i]M[/i][/color]aterial.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: N.B.M?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: As in `Not Boyfriend Material?`
nodes.text_bbcode: As in [color=#3b78e2][i]Not Boyfriend Material?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No... I meant something else!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Speak up, peasant-boy!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Prissy, be nice to the poor!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I mean, if there's one thing all the girls at Centerscore say about him, it's that he's...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Great. Another guy being manipulated by his parents.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yawn.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oof.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I didn't know he was `forbidden!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't know he was [color=#3b78e2][i]forbidden![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: He... What?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yawn. Why do they even put book stores in malls? They just take up space that could be used to sell shoes.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Oh, remember what his parents said?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, um, yeah. His parents said that he...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: What? But that excludes `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? But that excludes [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, `and me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [color=#3b78e2][i]and me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: How mopey!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Who wants to date Mr. Doldrum?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That didn't work...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: After... All... What?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Never mind. Stuff.
Jacob returns to the guys...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, did Sam give you any help?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I know a lot. I know that they care more about their trust funds than they do about trust.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You want my advice? Don't try to fix up a vulnerable guy just because he thinks some girl's `'hot.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want my advice? Don't try to fix up a vulnerable guy just because he thinks some girl's [color=#3b78e2][i]'hot.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How ready is Phil? Does he know anything about her? When he came to me for relationship advice earlier, he seemed pretty sad...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He seems sad when he's on the court, too.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: He is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, he isn't really ready for a relationship then, is he? And he certainly isn't ready for the kind of rejection rich girls can dish out.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoops... I forgot that Sam doesn't really like a lot of the rich girls she knows...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. If one more person asks me for love advice, I swear, I'm going to...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Saa-aam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know! I know!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Jacob. $ZOE's trying to get me to embrace my newfound talent, but after Valentine's Day, I wouldn't mind a vacation.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I understand...
$ZOE gives Sam a little nudge.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sigh. Fine. Do you know this girl's name?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I overheard her friend call her Madisenn.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I went to school with her! She'd be perfect for Phil!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If she could get past the fact that her family has like a billion dollars more than his...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, here's what you need to do... You need to make Phil seem `exclusive.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, here's what you need to do... You need to make Phil seem [color=#3b78e2][i]exclusive.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Exclusive?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, like something Madisenn wants but can't have. Like a club she can't belong to. In the rich girl's eyes, exclusivity is the only thing greater than money.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But what about honesty? I mean, Phil's not exactly hard-to-get.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Normally, honesty is the most important thing for a relationship. But in this case, honesty will kill Phil's chances. Hopefully by the time Madisenn learns the truth, she'll already like Phil.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good luck!
After several hours of video game playing...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know about you guys... But my eyes could use a break.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Ditto.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That's how I lost my eye. I played video games for too many hours in a row and fried it.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What should we do now?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I've got an idea...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: My parents have a landline phone with a private number. It's perfect for making prank phone calls.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Let's do it! I say we use it to prank call Colt.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Colt? Isn't messing around with him a bad idea?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: He'll never know it's us! Jacob's parents' number won't show up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: But what do you have against Colt?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: A couple months ago, he used me to hustle some college guys. I had to fight my way out... Got a black eye. Now I feel like I owe him one.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: So, you're going to make the call?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I would, but I think he'll recognize my voice.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Mine, too. For reasons I can't disclose.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I think the captain should do it...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Okay, wimps. I'll make the call. What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You should pretend to be Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Perfect.
Jacob dials Colt's number...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Time to put on my best Monte impression!
Across town, Colt's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `'Hello, Shoemaker!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Hello, Shoemaker!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Officer Monte? How did you get my number?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `'A new government program designed to crack down on ruffians like you, Clyde!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'A new government program designed to crack down on ruffians like you, Clyde!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The government gave you my phone number?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `'Yes... Among other things.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Yes... Among other things.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Other things?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `'Addresses, shopping habits, routines. In short, Clyde, I'll be watching you. Waiting for the moment when you slip up.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'Addresses, shopping habits, routines. In short, Clyde, I'll be watching you. Waiting for the moment when you slip up.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't believe you.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: `'I know you do. I can hear it in your voice. Try to be on your best behavior, son! Otherwise, it's Boot Camp for you! Remember... Your best behavior.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]'I know you do. I can hear it in your voice. Try to be on your best behavior, son! Otherwise, it's Boot Camp for you! Remember... Your best behavior.'[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jacob ends the call.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: HahahaHA! That was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You should be an actor, man! You sounded just like him.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You're my new idol, sir. Impressive.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey, Colt. This is Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Right. Who is this really?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Um, it's me. Officer Monte. And my moustache is watching you... Or something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ha ha. Is this Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No. I've never heard of a Kenji. Is that a soup?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Hang up, dude! He's onto us!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Who was that? That `definitely` sounded like Kenji... Tell him the basketball team doesn't have a chance against Spartan.
nodes.text_bbcode: Who was that? That [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] sounded like Kenji... Tell him the basketball team doesn't have a chance against Spartan.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Um, never mind that. I'll arrest you, dude.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That sounds awesome. Look, I gotta go. This was one of the best prank calls I've ever received.
Colt ends the call.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: 'My moustache is watching you?!'

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That was horrible. You sounded like a donkey with hiccups.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. I thought I could do it...
The guys head to the mall to pick up girls...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Did you remember to invite Erik?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Whoops. I totally forgot.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Eh. Whatever, he'd probably run from girls, anyway. By the way, who `are` we wing-manning for?
nodes.text_bbcode: Eh. Whatever, he'd probably run from girls, anyway. By the way, who [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] we wing-manning for?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Good question. I think we should try to hook Phil up with someone!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Why me?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You're our top rebounder, and you're on the rebound. Need we say more?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: To be honest, I don't know if I need any help. Hector's been teaching me his system...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Is it working?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Actually... No. All the girls I've tried it on have been too rich for it to work. They said I was N.B.M... Not Boyfriend Material...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Rich girls? Like those girls over by that bookstore?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Actually, those exact girls.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: This is perfect. Dames love it when you're persistent. Let's go! Wingman wings activate! `Ker-zoop!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is perfect. Dames love it when you're persistent. Let's go! Wingman wings activate! [color=#e23b3b][i]Ker-zoop![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I hate gift cards `so` much, Madisenn. It's like my cheaper relatives are `forcing` me to shop with the poor.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate gift cards [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much, Madisenn. It's like my cheaper relatives are [color=#3b78e2][i]forcing[/i][/color] me to shop with the poor.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I don't know what you're talking about! Mall people are so interesting! They shop without servants. It's so quaint!
Jacob sees Sam and $ZOE in the checkout line...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wait! We need help understanding these girls... And I know just who to talk to.
Jacob walks over to Sam and $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hi, girls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bummer about the losses for the basketball team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You going to beat Spartan?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're trying.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sam, I wanted to ask you for some advice. Phil's interested in this girl, but she's rich, and she's already rejected him once.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm asking because you...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What? I'm not playing as Ball Hog. He's not that good of a character.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: That's not what I meant. I meant that you `are` a ball-hog.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's not what I meant. I meant that you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] a ball-hog.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No, I'm not. I'm Mr. Unbearable. Ball Hog is that spherical pig character.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: His mire-ball attack is weak, but he has a lot of good grappling moves.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, that was an unfortunate coincidence... I don't know if Andy's ever going to learn to pass...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: This is exactly how you are on the court. You think you're the best player, so you never pass and give other people a chance. We're a `team,` Andy.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is exactly how you are on the court. You think you're the best player, so you never pass and give other people a chance. We're a [color=#e23b3b][i]team,[/i][/color] Andy.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's my turn to play. Give up the controller.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Here, Phil. Sorry, guys. I guess it didn't seem like that big of a deal until I saw it here, `now.` Off the court.
nodes.text_bbcode: Here, Phil. Sorry, guys. I guess it didn't seem like that big of a deal until I saw it here, [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color] Off the court.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Thanks, Andy. After I crush Kenji's Rodentist, you can get another chance to prove yourself.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I will.
After school the next day...
All right. We've only got time to do three things over the next three days. What should we do first?
After school...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Only two days left. What should we do today?
After school...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Just one more day left...
The guys meet in Manny's Mani's...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Thanks for showing, guys.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I don't know what we're doing here, man. This is lame.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I agree with Kenji on this one. What happened to the plan?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I called an audible...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What are we? A bunch of pom-pom waving...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, basketball team! What are you guys doing here?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Just trying new things to build our chemistry up.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Awesome! A good manicure can really change your mood.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Look, it's not like it's going to turn us `into` girls.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, it's not like it's going to turn us [color=#e23b3b][i]into[/i][/color] girls.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Even if it did, we might be a better basketball team...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Fine! But if anyone blabs about this... They're dead.
The guys get their manicures...
At practice the next day...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What is wrong with you, Phil?! `CATCH THE BALL!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What is wrong with you, Phil?! [color=#e23b3b][i]CATCH THE BALL![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But I might break a nail!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What's the matter with you, Coach? You're always yelling!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm feeling two emotions at the same time! `What's happening to me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no! I'm feeling two emotions at the same time! [color=#e23b3b][i]What's happening to me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Woah! Maybe manicures was `too` girly.
nodes.text_bbcode: Woah! Maybe manicures was [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] girly.

nodes.text: Jacob feminized the basketball team! This can't be right! Try again, but this time stay away from `that` idea!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jacob feminized the basketball team! This can't be right! Try again, but this time stay away from [b]that[/b] idea!

nodes.text: The guys show up at Jacob's house for Guys' Night.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: So, what's the plan? What are we going to do? And where's that Erik guy?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Oh, whoops. I forgot to invite him. Oh well...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We're going to do what guys do when they're alone together...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh, man. I'm really tired of braiding hair!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Look, we're not braiding hair. We're playing video games!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Sweet!
The guys play for awhile...
On an apocalyptic coastal wasteland, after a brutal battle...

nodes.speaker: The Rodentist
nodes.text: You're nothing more than tartar to me!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Unbearable
nodes.text: I wish I had made more practice at the academies! Grrrowl!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Haha! I destroyed you, Andy. The Rodentist is the best character in this game!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That was so cheap. Mr. Unbearable is way better. I demand a rematch.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Man! Andy lost. He's supposed to pass the controller along, but he's hogging it the same way he does with the basketball. I've got to say something...
Nearly a perfect shot! Try again and see if you can unlock the bonus scene to see what else is going on around Centerscore!
Congratulations! You helped Jacob build the basketball team's chemistry and make the post-season! What a great game!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No. I've got this one, Jacob. Team MVP to the rescue!
Andy tries to go by his man, but dribbles the ball off his foot! It rolls right to Jacob!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Phil! `Phil!` Are you listening?
nodes.text_bbcode: Phil! [color=#e23b3b][i]Phil![/i][/color] Are you listening?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Urg! He's still hung up on Kim!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No, we can't. You're always so optimistic! But, you're wrong. We couldn't clean the beach, and we're about to lose this game!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We can at least try...
It's the basketball team's last game, their final chance to make the post-season...
The bleachers are packed with students, and the cheerleaders are getting everyone fired up with a cheer!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Gooooooooo Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Crush Spartan!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yaaaaay basketball!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Oh, man, the pressure is on! Let's go, Centerscore!
Meanwhile, on the court...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Let's see what you sorry sacks of buffalo meat can do!
The game progresses until there's only a few seconds left, and Centerscore is down by just one point!
Jacob pulls the guys into a quick huddle...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: All right, guys, this is it. There's time for one more play. We've got the ball, and all we need is two points.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We can do this.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When the chips are down, does Captain Jean-Paul Pico surrender the Undertaking?! `No he does not!`
nodes.text_bbcode: When the chips are down, does Captain Jean-Paul Pico surrender the Undertaking?! [color=#e23b3b][i]No he does not![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Nerd. Please stop talking.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Powering down...
The Spartan Academy players sneer at Jacob as he picks the ball up.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I hope you're not expecting to win, simpleton!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: You don't have a chance.
Jacob passes the ball in to Kenji...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Phil, get close to the hoop!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Kenji, I'm open!
Kenji throws a bounce pass to Andy.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Andy! Pass it here!
Jacob squares up to the hoop and shoots just before the buzzer sounds!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: The shot misses, but the ref's whistle blows!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I got fouled! Now I've got to make some free throws...
Suddenly, Tom Prince storms onto the court!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hey, kid, this is a basketball game!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is my life! And this idiot is trying to ruin it!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know about you and my girl, er, lady... Friend, who I'm dating... Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Kim?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wretch! I knew it!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: What is he talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't play dumb, jock. I know she was giving you advice about the team!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's who you were getting advice from?! No wonder we went to the mall!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: She was giving me advice, Tom, but that's it. Nothing happened. I swear.
Tom glares at Jacob for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Very well...
He turns to leave... As he does so, he talks into a walkie-talkie.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Stand-down, Jeeves. It was a false alarm. See if you can get a refund on that horse tranquilizer... The darts, too.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I can't believe you got help from Kim!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You lied to us, man.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I quit!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Me, too!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Shoot your stupid free throws without us!
The guys walk off the court.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Where's everyone going?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: At least they're finally all in agreement about something... Too bad that something is hating me.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: What did you do, Jacob?!
Jacob caused the entire basketball team to quit! That can't be right. Play again and see if you can keep everybody on the court!
